mentions.note: Junior Championship success in the 880 yards

mentions.h: Sat. June 12th. v. London Fire Force S.A. at Tooting Bec Track.
mentions.note: 'our young Southern Junior Champion'; turning out again
won Corps 800m and 1,500m; 3rd 800m International Meeting, Antwerp, 1.58.8; won 1,500m Armed Forces Olympic Games, Berlin, 4:01.2
second in second section of "Services" 1 Mile, British Games; third 800 metres for A.A.A. at Antwerp in 1:58.5
non-starter in the 1 mile, club championships, Tooting, 2 August
won the 880 yards, return match v. South London H., Tooting, 20 August
first Englishman in a record-breaking 1 mile at the A.A.A. championships; represented England v. France in Paris
led the winning 1 mile medley relay team, inter-club match at Banstead, 24 May
made the pace and finished 3rd in the 1 mile final in a record 4 min. 10.6 secs., A.A.A. championships
Olympic 1,500 metres, 2nd in heat in 3:55.8, 6th in final in 3:52.6
resigned; building up Old Woking A.C.
